parameters.name: CreateRulesList
parameters.description: A list of associated resource tag rules.

sub_parameters.name: SettingName
sub_parameters.description:
The setting name of the associated resource tag rule.

For valid values, see the **Setting name** column in [Resources that support associated resource tagging](~~2586330~~).

sub_parameters.name: Status
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the associated resource tag rule. Valid values:

- Enable (default): The rule is enabled.

- Disable: The rule is disabled.

sub_parameters.name: TagKeys
sub_parameters.description: The tag keys to which the rule applies.
